postal.title: Seasonal post office · confirmed
postal.description: British Antarctic Territory postage is hand-cancelled at Port Lockroy. UKAHT separately applies souvenir cachets. Official examples document mail carried by visiting vessels to Stanley, Falkland Islands, before onward transmission.

postal.title: Postal history documented · current counter details unverified
postal.description: Kings Bay documents the history of the original post office building; Norway Post lists Ny-Ålesund among datestamps available through philatelic services, including tools taken over from closed offices. The stamp of a historic building and its souvenirs must not be mistaken for a current postal cancellation.
